description: Letter from Yefet b. Menashshe to one of his brothers. In Judaeo-Arabic. Two fragments. Mentions Abū Ṭālib, a qāḍī with many concerns, and Manṣūr. The addressee had suffered an attack of colic (qawlanj) but is now feeling better. Yefet also mentions "the large notebook of seliḥot." Join: Oded Zinger.
description_he: מכתב ביהודית-ערבית. מוזכרים אבו טאלב, קאדי עם עניינים רבים, ומנצור. ייתכן שבכתב ידו המוקדמת של חלפון בן מנשה, אך אין ודאות.
